officialSources.observation: Official BEV service page states public free cadastral map/API without access restrictions, no owner information, daily updating, and direct integration. Legal-coordinate limitations and conditions retained as notices.
BEV cadastral map product information; national scope.

Official viewer script and linked map style expose public vector tile and parcel-reference lookup endpoints. Embedded help states zoom 16 geometries are depicted with centimetre accuracy but do not yield legally binding coordinates.

requests.outcome: Viewer shell and observed script reference read.
Official style lists gst polygon layer.
Public client reveals api/all, api/gst/{kg}/{gnr}, and help describing vector data.
Cadastral reference 01004-1 found; geometry is a bounding rectangle, not the parcel shape.
Exact-reference metadata again returns bounding rectangle.
Viewer exact object-id lookup also returns bounding rectangle.
72457-byte HTTP200 protobuf tile decoded to gst layer with 252 parcel polygon features; extent65536. Three polygons strictly inside the tile retained as safe examples.
